name: HiveMQ Cloud
tagline: Enterprise MQTT broker cloud with REST management for clusters, credentials, and traffic control
description: HiveMQ Cloud is a fully managed MQTT platform that provides enterprise-grade MQTT broker infrastructure along with REST APIs for cluster management, client credentials, and MQTT traffic control. Developers use it to provision MQTT environments, manage authentication credentials, and control broker-side messaging behavior without operating their own broker infrastructure.

auth.details: API token authentication; exact header and self-serve details verified from official docs when available

use_cases: list HiveMQ Cloud clusters for an account
create or rotate MQTT client credentials
inspect cluster connection details for device onboarding
manage MQTT access control for IoT fleets
